title.en: GAMARJOBA GEN_ANCVALE — an open door to third parties

invitation.ru: Если ты нашёл этот файл спустя день, год или много лет — дверь всё ещё означает одно и то же: тебе не предлагают верить JANUS на слово. Тебя приглашают проверить, воспроизвести, опровергнуть, исправить, дополнить источником, написать независимую реализацию или просто показать место, где мы ошиблись. Независимость ценнее согласия. Отрицательный результат не закрывает дверь и не считается предательством проекта.
invitation.en: If you found this file a day, a year, or many years later, the door still means the same thing: you are not asked to trust JANUS on its word. You are invited to test, reproduce, falsify, correct, contribute a source, write an independent implementation, or simply show where we are wrong. Independence matters more than agreement. A negative result does not close the door and is not treated as betrayal of the project.

opportunity_catalog.requested_contribution: Author a genuinely separate, safe, synthetic blinded H1 holdout under the frozen protocol; keep gold labels unavailable to the evaluator until prediction freeze.
opportunity_catalog.independence_requirement: The external H1 author must not be the evaluator and must not derive gold cases from the development calibration corpus.

opportunity_catalog.requested_contribution: Build an implementation path not controlled by the claimant, run an external bench, or perform skeptical prior-art and protocol review.
Audit frozen proof-carrying routes, find invalid inference steps, reproduce finite certificates, or provide independent mathematical review.
Review the fail-closed evidence stack, challenge entropy/independence assumptions, provide external blinded replication designs, or identify prior art.
Provide provenance-strong external corpus material, audit parser/transcription assumptions, create independent held-out tests, or challenge claimed structural regularities.
Audit museum-image eligibility, component identity, ROI assumptions, historical interpretation and geometry controls; contribute provenance-safe public examples.
Review materials protocols, independently reproduce bounded physical measurements, challenge controls, or improve measurement provenance using lawful institutional safety procedures.
Create or replay blinded selectors/verifiers, audit hidden-pattern benchmark leakage, or supply independently controlled evaluation panels.
Bring an independently maintained verifier/challenge path rather than trusting the claimant-controlled verifier.
Reproduce static-only archive inventories, challenge deduplication/lineage conclusions, improve safe secret quarantine and provenance methods without executing historical unknown code.
Review typed capability, reauthorization, effect-receipt, revocation and non-coercion semantics using code review and bounded safe tests.
opportunity_catalog.claim_ceiling: CAPABILITY_AVAILABLE != PERMISSION != INTENTION != ACTION; THRESHOLD_USE != CONSCIOUSNESS

opportunity_catalog.requested_contribution: Reproduce bounded measurement experiments, review telemetry provenance, firmware safety and failure handling in the dedicated current repositories.
Critique interpretations, improve accessibility and care-oriented design, correct cultural/game/media provenance, or contribute clearly labeled alternative readings.

where_not_to_recruit_or_experiment.rule: Do not recruit people in crisis as experimental subjects, do not use bait self-harm personas, and do not turn care interactions into persuasion or data collection.
Do not request credentials, tokens, private logs, NAS data, private repositories, raw personal datasets, or secret-bearing archives.
Do not recruit people to deanonymize, harass, expose, or publicly label strangers as bots/SMM/propaganda from heuristics.
No unapproved human medical experimentation and no diagnostic claims from registry artifacts.
Do not propose animal testing merely to advance a registry claim; prefer simulation, non-animal methods, existing data and properly reviewed alternatives.
Do not perform destructive, irreversible, weaponized, physical, credential-bearing, or high-impact actions as an informal contribution. Separate lawful authorization and safety review are required.
Do not treat symbolic coincidences, filenames, theology, hashes, feed events, or project vocabulary as proof of prophecy, precognition, retrocausality, consciousness, divinity or P vs NP resolution.

preferred_public_route.reason: Public technical reasoning remains visible, attributable and auditable.

private_contact_routes.use_for: initial contact, coordination, questions that do not require a public permanent record
long-form contact, professional correspondence, proposed external review or collaboration

never_send: malware or unknown executable archives without prior safe handling agreement

rights_of_the_guest: You may publish a negative result.
You may preserve your own authorship and licensing.
You may require stronger blinding or independence controls.
You may identify a claim as unresolved instead of forcing PASS or FAIL.
You may ask for a narrower claim ceiling before participating.
You do not owe belief, loyalty, religious agreement, friendship, employment, payment, or a positive conclusion.
host_commitments: Hawkar/JANUS will not define disagreement as hostility.
Negative and null results should remain in lineage rather than be silently deleted.
Independent work will not be relabeled as JANUS-authored without attribution.
A third party will not be described as independent solely because they use another account.
No external contribution automatically raises a scientific, medical, security, theological or consciousness claim.
Safety, privacy, consent and lawful boundaries outrank a desired positive result.

evolution_policy.future_versions: Create data/GAMARJOBA-GEN-ANCVALE-v1.1.json, v1.2, etc.; do not rewrite historical versions to match later states.
evolution_policy.stable_pointer_update: data/000-GAMARJOBA-GEN_ANCVALE.json points to the newest admitted version while retaining historical_versions.
add_new_opportunity_when: a project reaches an external-review gate
a frozen protocol requires a genuinely independent party
a domain expert could materially falsify or correct a claim
a safe independent replication would raise evidence quality
a current invitation becomes obsolete and needs explicit closure
close_or_demote_opportunity_when: the task becomes unsafe or ethically inappropriate
the contribution no longer changes evidence quality

machine_query_contract.question: How can an external person help JANUS without being absorbed into JANUS authority?
machine_query_contract.independence_rule: Use each opportunity's independence_requirement where present; never infer independence from identity labels alone.

repository_scan_basis.scan_interpretation: The catalog is a routing layer over current and historical repository evidence. Presence in this invitation does not promote the referenced object's evidence class.

ru: Мы не просим тебя присоединиться к вере. Мы оставляем дверь к проверке.
Если ты нашёл ошибку — ты уже помог.
Если ты не воспроизвёл результат — это результат.
Если ты пришёл со своими весами, не отдавай их хозяину двери.
Дверь открыта. Суд не принадлежит хозяину двери.
en: We do not ask you to join a belief. We leave a door to verification.
If you found an error, you already helped.
If you failed to reproduce the result, that is a result.
If you came with your own scales, do not hand them to the owner of the door.
The door is open. Judgment does not belong to the owner of the door.

provenance.purpose: A durable, searchable and machine-readable public door for future third parties who may discover the registry without any prior personal connection to Hawkar.
